title: Emergency administrative access when the normal hybrid path fails
purpose: Recover a narrowly scoped administration path when federation/PTA, normal administrator MFA or a normal access policy blocks access, while Microsoft Entra cloud authentication and the target management service remain reachable.

scope.permittedTarget: Only two pre-created synthetic cloud-only emergency accounts and one disposable test group explicitly named in an approval.
scope.notAClaim: Cloud-only is independent of on-premises federation/PTA, not independent of Microsoft Entra, internet access, the account's registered authentication method, applicable authentication requirements, or the target service.
excluded: Tenant-wide or Microsoft Entra outage recovery
Deletion of accounts, methods or logs
Using ITSM, PIM approval, the normal IdP or a cloud password vault as a bootstrap requirement

sourceReferences.qualification: Independent emergency methods still depend on the cloud authentication service. Confirm current method support and enforced authentication requirements in the approved tenant.
Ticket synchronization is workflow evidence, not the authorization or bootstrap mechanism for recovery.

prerequisites.requirement: Written lab approval names both accounts, test group, permitted operations, window, observer and rollback owner.
prerequisites.evidence: Approval reference and target allow-list; no credentials.

prerequisites.requirement: Two cloud-only accounts use the tenant's .onmicrosoft.com domain, have no synchronized/federated dependency, have permanent-active Global Administrator assignments, and have separately controlled authentication methods from normal administrators. This documented emergency exception is not normal just-in-time elevation.
prerequisites.evidence: Redacted identity-source, permanent-active role, method inventory and custody attestation.

prerequisites.requirement: A supported phishing-resistant method is enrolled and accessible from a protected clean workstation. Exclude these accounts from blocking/restricting Conditional Access, retain report-only observation as appropriate, and verify compatibility with current platform-enforced authentication requirements; do not lower authentication assurance to create an emergency path.
prerequisites.evidence: Method-support record, exclusion/policy evaluation, workstation attestation and recovery instructions.

prerequisites.requirement: Independent custodian can retrieve the emergency method without Entra/AD sign-in to the normal password vault, PIM approval or ITSM availability.
prerequisites.evidence: Sealed offline custody/dual-control procedure and observed retrieval time; never export the secret.

prerequisites.requirement: Monitoring covers success/failure and audit activity for both accounts, with a second route if the primary SIEM is unavailable.
prerequisites.evidence: Rule definition, independent observer route, tested alert delivery and retention policy.

prerequisites.requirement: Baseline permissions and exact reversible test action exist before the drill; normal administrator path is not actually disrupted.
prerequisites.evidence: Allow-listed disposable group description value before/after and approval.

dependencyLimits.dependency: Microsoft Entra cloud authentication and target control plane
dependencyLimits.failureBehavior: Stop and escalate vendor incident; this runbook cannot authenticate through a full Entra/control-plane outage.

dependencyLimits.dependency: Registered emergency method, clean workstation, DNS, time and internet path
dependencyLimits.failureBehavior: Try only the separately custodied approved second method/account; do not lower tenant controls ad hoc.

dependencyLimits.dependency: Normal on-premises federation/PTA, normal administrator method, PIM and ITSM
dependencyLimits.failureBehavior: They must not be required for emergency bootstrap; observe rather than disrupt them.
Use pre-approved independent observer/evidence capture; absence of all required monitoring is a failed drill, not success.

steps.action: Check signed scope, UTC window and exact synthetic targets. Record stop contacts and current service status without changing a service.
steps.expected: All targets and operations are allow-listed; normal production paths are unaffected.

steps.action: Arm the approved alert observation path and an independent time-stamped evidence log; do not suppress security alerts for the exercise.
steps.expected: Observer can receive/retain a test notification without depending on the emergency account.
steps.onFailure: Stop; monitoring prerequisites are not met.

steps.action: Retrieve the first separately controlled method on the approved clean workstation using the offline custody procedure.
steps.expected: No normal IdP/PIM/ticket/vault sign-in is required to retrieve it.
steps.onFailure: Record circular dependency and stop; do not improvise credentials.

steps.action: Start a fresh private session, sign in with synthetic emergency account one using its approved independent method, and capture the resulting account/tenant identifiers.
steps.expected: Fresh interactive sign-in succeeds through the cloud path, not a cached session or normal federation/PTA path.
steps.onFailure: Record error and service/method dependency; stop or use the separately approved second-account check.
evidence: Observed authentication method and policy result

steps.action: Read the approved group's baseline and perform only the reversible approved description update; do not change roles, policies, methods or unrelated objects.
steps.expected: The intended emergency permission works for exactly the permitted action.
steps.onFailure: Stop without broadening privilege; record a failed permission test.

steps.action: Match every sign-in and mutation with alert/audit records and measure receipt latency against the approved objective.
steps.expected: Every use is visible with actor, target, time and outcome; a missed/late alert fails monitoring acceptance.
steps.onFailure: Preserve evidence, end the drill and remediate monitoring before reliance.

steps.action: Restore the test group's baseline value, sign out, then repeat the fresh-session method and monitoring checks for separately controlled emergency account two within its approval.
steps.expected: Both accounts work independently; the second is not merely another account bound to the same inaccessible normal method/custodian.
steps.onFailure: Record partial failure; one successful account does not satisfy two-account acceptance.

steps.action: Compare configuration/permissions to baseline, reconcile all evidence, restore custody, apply credential/method handling required by policy, and schedule the next review.
steps.expected: No unintended changes persist and the next validation date is recorded; replacement enrollment, if necessary, needs its own approved scope.
steps.onFailure: Escalate incident/change process and retain the failed outcome.

steps: Cease mutations and preserve correlation IDs.
Using only approved authority, restore the disposable group's baseline value.
Sign out sessions and follow the approved account/method custody handling; do not disable the only remaining emergency path.
Verify no role/policy/method drift and retain the failed drill record.
acceptance: Disposable object equals its trusted baseline
Both emergency paths remain available or their loss is escalated
Evidence is retained outside the exercised account

passCriteria: Two distinct fresh cloud-only sign-ins using separately controlled approved methods
Only the allow-listed reversible test operation succeeds
Every use and action is matched to monitoring within the approved threshold
failCriteria: Cached session used as fresh authentication evidence
Either account or required independent method fails
No observed alert, missing audit record or unknown target change
Recovery depends on the failed normal chain
Claiming independence from a full Entra outage
evidenceRequirements: Two fresh sign-in records with correlation IDs
Permitted operation before/after and audit IDs

expected: All pass criteria observed in an approved isolated tenant.
validation.blocker: Only local synthetic fixtures/browser tests are authorized. No Entra lab or emergency account use is approved.
